subject: we're taking the spam battle up a notch

messages.author: dd632bd3bbcdd7e9
messages.subject: we're taking the spam battle up a notch
parts:
Dear nimble-users,

Our list has been remarkably spam-free for most of its existence, but that has changed recently, evidently from a small number of sources that keep creating new users and posting from them. Depending on your individual spam filters, you may or may not be seeing the spam on your end. We've had some success training the google group's filters to catch spam before it is sent to you. A significant amount is now getting filtered this way (which we then moderate, so we'll catch any false positives). However there is still too much of it getting through. We found a setting that forces posts by new users to go through moderation, and we have turned that on. We didn't want to do that because we like that users could join the list and post without any barriers or delays, but this moderation step seems like the best option to stop the spam. Fingers crossed that these spam sources will go away if their messages never get through.

Perry and the nimble team
